title: Count Subarrays With Majority Element I
summary: Given an integer array and a target, count the subarrays where the target appears more than half the time.
statement: Given an integer array and a target, count the subarrays where the target appears more than half the time.
constraints: nums contains up to 1,000 positive integers.
A subarray qualifies when target appears strictly more than half its length.
Return the total number of qualifying contiguous subarrays.
hints: Fixing a left boundary lets the target count update in constant time as the right boundary grows.
Enumerate all right endpoints, increment the count on target matches, and test twice the count against the window length.
Add one exactly when the strict-majority inequality holds.
Every contiguous subarray has one enumerated endpoint pair and its maintained count is exact.
editorial: Every contiguous subarray has one enumerated endpoint pair and its maintained count is exact.

tests.explanation: Five subarrays contain two strictly more than half the time.
Every one of the ten subarrays has target one as its majority.
